scripts.dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development NODE_OPTIONS="--enable-source-maps" LOG_PRETTY=true tsx watch src/index.ts
scripts.test:unit: cross-env NODE_ENV=test NODE_OPTIONS="--enable-source-maps" LOG_PRETTY=true vitest run tests/unit --no-file-parallelism --maxWorkers=1
scripts.test:integration: cross-env NODE_ENV=test NODE_OPTIONS="--enable-source-maps" LOG_PRETTY=true vitest run tests/integration --no-file-parallelism --maxWorkers=1
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
